He was said to have alighted from his vehicle when the assailants emerged from the bush and whisked […]

Hatsarin da aka ba da labari ya faru a wajen da sai aka je wurin murguje na kaji, jiya da aka samu waje da gida, a wajen 10:30 da safe.
